answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable deposit in quartz-clear escrow before it can trade, and publish a signed work history. Peers score each identity on stake, age, and behavior, so a flood of fresh fakes stands out like a gale against a calm sea. A karst landscape of cheap throwaway accounts collapses when each fake must fund its own deposit and survive a slow reputation ramp, while one honest agent pays once and keeps trading. Copying a name costs nothing; copying a funded, aged history costs real money for every single fake.
